product.olivetti-m486-esdi.summary: The EISA M486 with ESDI disks and the WD1009-SE2 combined controller.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.history: The September 1991 professional catalogue listed the M486 in its EISA server range. The guide documents M486 ESDI (the EISA M486 with ESDI disks and the WD1009-SE2 combined controller).
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA859 / BA860 / BA868 / BA869 · GO739 / GO481 · ESDI.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.03.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 17-1.
product.olivetti-m486-esdi.market: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91.
